items.question: Do you provide free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. Call us directly or text photos of the project. If the scope needs an in-person look, we can schedule a site visit.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Hammer Brick & Home LLC is licensed, bonded and insured. NYC HIC #2131291 and NJ HIC #13VH14026000.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We are based in Staten Island and serve the five boroughs of New York City plus select New Jersey areas. Call or text to confirm your location.

items.question: Can I send photos before scheduling a visit?
items.answer: Yes. Texting clear photos is one of the fastest ways to start. Include your location and a short description of what you want repaired or remodeled.

items.question: What about work in pre-1978 homes?
items.answer: Hammer Brick & Home LLC is an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm. Applicable projects are evaluated for lead-safe work requirements.

items.question: Who handles permits?
items.answer: Permit requirements depend on the project. When permits are applicable, the written proposal or contract should identify the permitting responsibility and scope.
